integrity: Finite checker reproduces exact arithmetic; unrestricted assertions rest on the accompanying analytic proof.
scientific_limitations: Only equal-sized classes admit the claimed universal circular balancing optimum; a three-class unequal-size example has conflicting best start allocations at two time horizons.
Start vertices must be independently uniform conditional on their predetermined classes; directed complete successive-class transitions are essential.
Integer-time asymptotics hold only along subsequences with convergent lattice centering.
Independent mathematical validation and exhaustive historical priority verification have not been performed.
title: Balanced cyclic starts optimize parallel-walk cover times on directed periodic networks
